breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — Civics Unit 2: Election, Political Parties and Pressure Groups — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Kudavolai was the system of voting followed during the Chola period in Tamil Nadu. We celebrate National Voters Day on 25th January in India.

en.q: Which system of voting was followed during the Chola period in Tamil Nadu?
en.explanation: National Voters Day is observed on 25 January.

ta.q: சோழர் காலத் தமிழகத்தில் பின்பற்றப்பட்ட வாக்களிப்பு முறை எது?

questions.quote: If people are not willing to elect any candidate, they can vote for the option NOTA (None Of The Above). Rule 49-O in the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 describes this procedure. VVPAT was first introduced in the 2014 General Election; India is the 14th country to introduce NOTA.

en.q: The procedure for NOTA is described in which rule of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961?
en.explanation: NOTA means None Of The Above.

ta.q: NOTA நடைமுறை 1961 தேர்தல் நடத்தை விதிகளின் எந்த விதியில் விளக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது?

questions.quote: Voters Verified Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) is the way forward to enhance credibility and transparency of the election process.

en.q: The VVPAT system was introduced to enhance:
options: the powers of the Lok Sabha Speaker
en.explanation: VVPAT stands for Voters Verified Paper Audit Trail.

ta.explanation: VVPAT – வாக்காளர் சரிபார்க்கும் காகிதத் தணிக்கைத் தடம்.

questions.quote: Direct elections: Lok Sabha, state Legislative Assemblies, local bodies (conducted by the state election commission). Demerits: expensive; illiterate voters misguided; payments in cash, goods or services; violence. Indirect elections: voters elect representatives who in turn elect – followed for the election of the President of India.

en.q: Which of the following is an indirect election?
options: Election of the President of India
en.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of elected members of Parliament and State Legislative Assemblies.

ta.explanation: குடியரசுத் தலைவரை நாடாளுமன்ற, மாநிலச் சட்டமன்றங்களின் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்ட உறுப்பினர் அடங்கிய தேர்வுக்குழு தேர்ந்தெடுக்கிறது.

questions.quote: The President of India is elected by an electoral college consisting of the elected members of both Houses of Parliament and the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of all states and Union territories. NOTE: The nominated members are not eligible to be included in the electoral college.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT part of the electoral college that elects the President of India?
options: Elected members of the Lok Sabha
Elected members of the Rajya Sabha
Elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies
en.explanation: Nominated members of either House of Parliament or State Assemblies are not eligible.

ta.q: இந்தியக் குடியரசுத் தலைவரைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கும் தேர்வுக்குழுவில் இடம்பெறாதவர்கள் யார்?
ta.explanation: இரு அவைகளிலும் மாநிலச் சட்டமன்றங்களிலும் நியமன உறுப்பினர்கள் தேர்வுக்குழுவில் சேர்க்கப்படமாட்டார்கள்.

questions.quote: A political party has three components: a leader, active members and the followers. Party systems: single-party (China, Cuba, former USSR), two-party (USA, UK), multi-party (India, Sri Lanka, France, Italy).

en.q: Which of the following lists correctly names countries with a multi-party system?
en.explanation: Single-party: China, Cuba, former USSR; two-party: USA, UK.

ta.q: பல கட்சி முறை உள்ள நாடுகளைச் சரியாகக் குறிப்பிடும் தொகுப்பு எது?
ta.explanation: ஒரு கட்சி முறை: சீனா, கியூபா, முன்னாள் சோவியத்; இரு கட்சி முறை: அமெரிக்கா, பிரிட்டன்.

questions.quote: The Leader of the Opposition enjoys the rank of a Cabinet Minister. As Chairman of the Public Accounts Committee he questions the functioning of government departments. He plays an important role in selecting the Chairman and members of the Central Vigilance Commission and the Information Commission.

en.q: The Leader of the Opposition in a democracy enjoys the rank of a:
en.explanation: He also plays a role in selecting members of the Central Vigilance Commission and Information Commission.

ta.q: மக்களாட்சியில் எதிர்க்கட்சித் தலைவர் எந்தப் பதவிக்கு இணையான தகுதி பெறுகிறார்?
ta.explanation: மத்திய கண்காணிப்பு ஆணையம், தகவல் ஆணையம் உறுப்பினர் தேர்விலும் அவர் பங்கு வகிக்கிறார்.

questions.quote: The term 'pressure group' originated in the USA. A pressure group is a group of people organised actively for promoting and defending their common interest. They are also called 'interest groups' or vested groups. They neither contest elections nor try to capture political power.

en.q: How do pressure groups differ from political parties?
options: They neither contest elections nor try to capture political power
They contest elections but never win
They have to register with the Election Commission
en.explanation: They try to bring change in public policy by exerting pressure on the government.

ta.q: அழுத்தக் குழுக்கள் அரசியல் கட்சிகளிலிருந்து எவ்வாறு வேறுபடுகின்றன?
options: தேர்தல் ஆணையத்தில் கட்டாயம் பதிவு செய்ய வேண்டும்
ta.explanation: அவை அரசின்மீது அழுத்தம் கொடுத்துப் பொதுக் கொள்கையில் மாற்றத்தை ஏற்படுத்த முயல்கின்றன.

questions.quote: Functions of pressure groups: representation, political participation, education, policy formulation and policy implementation. Pressure groups can be called the informal face of politics; mobilise popular support through petitions, marches, demonstrations.

en.q: Pressure groups have been called the:
en.explanation: They mobilise support through petitions, marches and demonstrations.

ta.explanation: மனுக்கள், பேரணிகள், ஆர்ப்பாட்டங்கள் மூலம் ஆதரவைத் திரட்டுகின்றன.
